Vs.

full_judgment: 4. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the petitioner, submitted that the proceeding as against the petitioner is bad in law and as such liable to be quashed for ends of justice. He further submitted that the allegations so made in the petition of complainant is absolutely illegal, false and have been made with a malafide intention only to harass and humiliate the accused-petitioner and the impugned proceeding is an abuse of the process of the Court and as such is liable to be quashed for ends of justice. He lastly submitted that no legal notice was served and the impugned proceeding started against him (petitioner) is a continuation of the abuse of the process of the Court and as such is liable to be quashed for the ends of justice.
